Located strategically in Bangalore, our centralized warehouse is the beating heart of Hamsalekha's operations. Staging setups are test-assembled, structural rigs undergo strict load-bearing checks, and electronics are system-tested before leaving for the venue.

We deploy absolute backup generators and secondary signal lines for all critical spotlights and staging consoles.
Every structural clamp, power cable, and automated bulb is tested at our facility prior to site delivery.
All high-suspended truss structures are double-locked with certified safety wires under veteran engineering supervision.
A standby engineering crew is stationed permanently on-site with spare parts for real-time adjustments.
